name: Anchovy
description: Cape anchovy (Engraulis encrasicolus) - one of the two great schooling plankton-eaters of the upwelling system. Life-stage group of the source model's juvenile and adult anchovy stanzas, measured separately and pooled here because the two stanzas form one population: young fish graze phytoplankton while adults filter a mixed plankton soup. Anchovy boomed as sardine collapsed, then waned with it - everything from seals to seabirds to tuna eats it.
